# Problem catalog

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask problems-docs` from `davhaven_wire::ProblemCode` (`crates/wire/src/problem.rs`). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every failure a client can see is one row of this catalog. The management API answers with an RFC 9457 problem document (`application/problem+json`) whose `type` is the URN of the row, whose `title` is its title and whose `code` is its code; MCP tool results carry the same document. The web pages and the feeds use the HTTP status of the row. A DAV client receives the DAV status of the row and, where the row has one, its precondition element in a `DAV:error` body. See [`api.md`](api.md#errors) for the document and [`interop.md`](interop.md) for the DAV side.

`code` is stable and the thing to branch on; `title` is the same for every occurrence, while `detail` and `errors[].message` are for people and may change. New rows are added over time: clients treat an unknown code like the generic problem of its HTTP status. Internal error text never reaches a client.

## Codes

| Code | HTTP | Type | Title | When it happens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bad-request` | 400 | `urn:davhaven:problem:bad-request` | Malformed request | The request cannot be parsed or is structurally malformed. |
| `unauthenticated` | 401 | `urn:davhaven:problem:unauthenticated` | Authentication required | No valid credential was presented. |
| `forbidden` | 403 | `urn:davhaven:problem:forbidden` | Not permitted | The caller may see the resource but is not permitted to do this. |
| `not-found` | 404 | `urn:davhaven:problem:not-found` | Resource not found | The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller (including other tenants' resources). |
| `method-not-allowed` | 405 | `urn:davhaven:problem:method-not-allowed` | Method not allowed | The method is not allowed on the resource. |
| `conflict` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:conflict` | Conflict with the current state | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. |
| `precondition-failed` | 412 | `urn:davhaven:problem:precondition-failed` | Precondition failed | A conditional request header does not match the current state. |
| `precondition-required` | 428 | `urn:davhaven:problem:precondition-required` | Precondition required | The request must be conditional. |
| `payload-too-large` | 413 | `urn:davhaven:problem:payload-too-large` | Request too large | The request or a value in it exceeds a size limit. |
| `unsupported-media-type` | 415 | `urn:davhaven:problem:unsupported-media-type` | Unsupported media type | The content type of the request is not accepted. |
| `validation-failed` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:validation-failed` | Validation failed | The request is well formed but a value is invalid; `errors` lists the offending fields. |
| `rate-limited` | 429 | `urn:davhaven:problem:rate-limited` | Too many requests | The caller exceeded a rate limit; `Retry-After` says when to try again. |
| `internal` | 500 | `urn:davhaven:problem:internal` | Internal error | An unexpected failure on the server. |
| `not-implemented` | 501 | `urn:davhaven:problem:not-implemented` | Not implemented | The operation is not available. |
| `unavailable` | 503 | `urn:davhaven:problem:unavailable` | Service unavailable | A dependency is unavailable; the request may be repeated later. |
| `idempotency-key-reuse` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:idempotency-key-reuse` | Idempotency key reused | An `Idempotency-Key` was reused with a different request. |
| `idempotency-in-progress` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:idempotency-in-progress` | Request in progress | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still being processed. |
| `secret-not-replayable` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:secret-not-replayable` | Secret cannot be replayed | The original response contained a secret, or could not be stored, so it cannot be replayed; the original request did take effect. |
| `feature-not-enabled` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:feature-not-enabled` | Feature not enabled | The feature is disabled for this deployment or tenant. |
| `invalid-calendar-data` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:invalid-calendar-data` | Invalid calendar data | The calendar data is not valid iCalendar or violates a limit (`CALDAV:valid-calendar-data`). |
| `invalid-calendar-object` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:invalid-calendar-object` | Invalid calendar object resource | The data breaks the rules for calendar object resources (`CALDAV:valid-calendar-object-resource`). |
| `unsupported-calendar-component` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:unsupported-calendar-component` | Unsupported calendar component | The calendar does not accept this component type (`CALDAV:supported-calendar-component`). |
| `unsupported-calendar-data` | 415 | `urn:davhaven:problem:unsupported-calendar-data` | Unsupported calendar data | The content is not iCalendar (`CALDAV:supported-calendar-data`). |
| `uid-conflict` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:uid-conflict` | UID already in use | Another object of the calendar has the UID (`CALDAV:no-uid-conflict`). |
| `resource-too-large` | 413 | `urn:davhaven:problem:resource-too-large` | Resource too large | The resource is larger than the maximum (`CALDAV:max-resource-size`). |
| `date-too-early` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:date-too-early` | Date too early | A date is before the minimum (`CALDAV:min-date-time`). |
| `date-too-late` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:date-too-late` | Date too late | A date is after the maximum (`CALDAV:max-date-time`). |
| `too-many-instances` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:too-many-instances` | Too many instances | The recurrence set has too many instances (`CALDAV:max-instances`). |
| `too-many-attendees` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:too-many-attendees` | Too many attendees | An instance has too many attendees (`CALDAV:max-attendees-per-instance`). |
| `scheduling-uid-conflict` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:scheduling-uid-conflict` | Scheduling object already exists | The owner already has a scheduling object with the UID (`CALDAV:unique-scheduling-object-resource`). |
| `organizer-mismatch` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:organizer-mismatch` | Organizer differs between components | Components disagree on the organizer (`CALDAV:same-organizer-in-all-components`). |
| `organizer-not-allowed` | 403 | `urn:davhaven:problem:organizer-not-allowed` | Organizer not allowed | The actor may not create a meeting with this organizer (`CALDAV:organizer-allowed`). |
| `organizer-change-not-allowed` | 403 | `urn:davhaven:problem:organizer-change-not-allowed` | Organizer change not allowed | An organizer change that is not allowed (`CALDAV:allowed-organizer-scheduling-object-change`). |
| `attendee-change-not-allowed` | 403 | `urn:davhaven:problem:attendee-change-not-allowed` | Attendee change not allowed | An attendee changed more than their own copy (`CALDAV:allowed-attendee-scheduling-object-change`). |
| `invalid-scheduling-message` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:invalid-scheduling-message` | Invalid scheduling message | The iTIP message is not valid (`CALDAV:valid-scheduling-message`). |
| `sync-token-expired` | 410 | `urn:davhaven:problem:sync-token-expired` | Sync token expired | The sync token is foreign, garbled, from another epoch or pruned (`DAV:valid-sync-token`). |
| `too-many-matches` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:too-many-matches` | Too many matches | The query matches too many resources (`DAV:number-of-matches-within-limits`). |
| `depth-infinity-refused` | 400 | `urn:davhaven:problem:depth-infinity-refused` | Infinite depth refused | `Depth: infinity` is refused (`DAV:propfind-finite-depth`). |
| `invalid-filter` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:invalid-filter` | Invalid filter | The query filter is invalid or exceeds a limit (`CALDAV:valid-filter`). |
| `resource-exists` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:resource-exists` | Resource already exists | The target of MKCALENDAR or MKCOL already exists (`DAV:resource-must-be-null`). |
| `protected-property` | 403 | `urn:davhaven:problem:protected-property` | Protected property | A protected property cannot be changed (`DAV:cannot-modify-protected-property`). |
| `sharing-not-allowed` | 403 | `urn:davhaven:problem:sharing-not-allowed` | Sharing not allowed | Sharing is not allowed for this calendar or tenant. |
| `invalid-sharee` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:invalid-sharee` | Invalid sharee | The sharee is not a valid target, for example an external address. |
| `name-reserved` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:name-reserved` | Name reserved | The name of a principal write belongs to a deleted principal that has not been purged yet (a write without `If-None-Match: *`; with it the answer is 412, like for every name that exists). |
| `external-ref-reserved` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:external-ref-reserved` | External reference reserved | The external reference belongs to a deleted principal that has not been purged yet. |
| `address-reserved` | 409 | `urn:davhaven:problem:address-reserved` | Address reserved | An address belongs to a deleted principal that has not been purged yet. |
| `unsupported-report` | 400 | `urn:davhaven:problem:unsupported-report` | Unsupported report | The report is not one the resource supports (`DAV:supported-report`, RFC 3253 section 3.6). |
| `too-many-hrefs` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:too-many-hrefs` | Too many resources named | A request names more resources than a limit allows: the hrefs of a `calendar-multiget`, the sharees of a `CS:share` (`DAV:number-of-matches-within-limits`). A query or a synchronization that matches too much is `too-many-matches`, which has the same element and another status. |
| `sync-traversal-unsupported` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:sync-traversal-unsupported` | Sync traversal not supported | A `sync-collection` asks for `sync-level` infinite (`DAV:sync-traversal-supported`, RFC 6578 sections 3.2 and 3.3). RFC 6578 gives no status of its own for it; like the other preconditions of the report (`DAV:valid-sync-token`) it is 403, the status RFC 4918 section 16 uses with a precondition element. |
| `foreign-destination` | 422 | `urn:davhaven:problem:foreign-destination` | Destination on another server | A `MOVE` or `COPY` names a destination on another server, which this server does not move to (RFC 4918 sections 9.8.5 and 9.9.4). |

## Protocol forms

The DAV status differs from the HTTP status where the WebDAV and CalDAV RFCs prescribe another answer (most preconditions are 403 with their element). An MCP client may repeat a call whose problem is retryable later; the tool result says so.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bad-request` | 400 |  | no |
| `unauthenticated` | 401 |  | no |
| `forbidden` | 403 | `DAV:need-privileges` | no |
| `not-found` | 404 |  | no |
| `method-not-allowed` | 405 |  | no |
| `conflict` | 409 |  | no |
| `precondition-failed` | 412 |  | no |
| `precondition-required` | 428 |  | no |
| `payload-too-large` | 413 |  | no |
| `unsupported-media-type` | 415 |  | no |
| `validation-failed` | 400 |  | no |
| `rate-limited` | 429 |  | yes |
| `internal` | 500 |  | no |
| `not-implemented` | 501 |  | no |
| `unavailable` | 503 |  | yes |
| `idempotency-key-reuse` | 400 |  | no |
| `idempotency-in-progress` | 409 |  | yes |
| `secret-not-replayable` | 409 |  | no |
| `feature-not-enabled` | 403 |  | no |
| `invalid-calendar-data` | 403 | `CALDAV:valid-calendar-data` | no |

| `scheduling-uid-conflict` | 403 | `CALDAV:unique-scheduling-object-resource` | no |
| `organizer-mismatch` | 403 | `CALDAV:same-organizer-in-all-components` | no |
| `organizer-not-allowed` | 403 | `CALDAV:organizer-allowed` | no |
